game_title: Max Finder Derby – Hollow Log Trail Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Max Finder Derby: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Track the biggest value seen so far while looping over contestants. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the wood elf archer ahead. Then check the best value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the mushroom ring by solving code steps involving best that move the wood elf archer forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the mushroom ring first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Max Finder Derby
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Max Finder Derby' (Week 5 slot 11), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Hollow Log Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how best changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cursed treants in Hollow Log Trail.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.0).
